hypotheses.M0_rotation_round_trips_are_exact: Every dense rotation round trip has relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.M1_native_privilege_survives_multiple_ro: At rank 256 native selection beats the best of seven rotated selections by at least 0.03 in median and has a pair-bootstrap 95% interval above zero in every cell.
hypotheses.M2_more_discovery_data_rescues_a_fixed_s: At one shared rank at most 1024, correct-family banks reach 0.50 fidelity, beat wrong-family banks by 0.05 with pair-bootstrap intervals above zero, and beat global banks by 0.03 in every cell.
hypotheses.M3_any_fixed_family_label_signal_is_univ: At one shared rank at most 1024, correct-minus-wrong pair-bootstrap intervals are above zero in every cell.
hypotheses.M4_family_banks_beat_generic_banks: At one shared rank at most 1024, correct-family banks beat global banks by at least 0.03 in every cell.
hypotheses.M5_fixed_banks_remain_weaker_than_dynami: At every tested rank through 1024, correct-family fidelity trails target-conditioned native fidelity by at least 0.15 in every cell.
hypotheses.M6_two_context_failure_was_not_just_esti: Increasing discovery from two to eight contexts per old lexical pair improves rank-256 correct-bank fidelity by less than 0.10 in every cell and does not make semantic-code rescue pass.
hypotheses.M7_family_bank_support_is_reproducible: Independent four-context halves of discovery have median rank-256 support Jaccard at least 0.20 at each layer.
